caseNameFull: Bob Camreta v. Sarah Greene, Personally and as Next Friend of S. G., a Minor, and K. G., a Minor James Alford, Deputy Sheriff, Deschutes County, Oregon v. Sarah Greene, Personally and as Next Friend of S. G., a Minor

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit granted. The cases are consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.

Same cases below, 588 F.3d 1011.
